title: farm-2026 flock roster
_note: PURPOSE: Describe the shape of content/flock-profiles.json — in particular the
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS HERE AND NOT IN farm-guardian: the plan named
validates. It is not. That file is the LM Studio structured-output schema for
the vision model (strict:true, additionalProperties:false) and is read by
scripts/replay-vlm-prompt.py. Adding roster fields to it would corrupt the VLM
contract. flock-profiles.json previously validated against nothing at all, so
this is a new, data-adjacent schema instead.
(dependency-free; jsonschema is not installed in the guardian venv).
This schema is deliberately PERMISSIVE about unknown top-level bird keys
(additionalProperties is not false): the roster has accumulated ~24 optional
per-bird fields over two years and locking it down would turn every future
Boss-added field into a validation failure. It is STRICT about the shape of
color_observations[] entries, which is the thing this change introduces.

date.description: ISO date the plumage was actually observed. null ONLY when date_unknown is true — never invent one.

date_unknown.description: true when the real observation date was not recoverable from the record. Must be true iff date is null.

age_weeks.description: Whole weeks between hatch_date and date. Present ONLY when the date is known AND hatch_date is known AND hatch_date_estimated is not true — omitted rather than guessed.

description.description: The plumage/color description as observed on that date.

note.description: Optional free-text provenance detail (e.g. which phrase in the record supplied the date).

ornitharch.description: Legacy unscoped 'hatched on this farm' flag. NOT year-scoped. For the year-scoped definition see flock_bands.json ornitharch_definition and roster.is_ornitharch(bird, year).

color_observations.description: Append-only, chronologically sorted (undated entries first) trail of dated plumage observations. The LAST entry is the current one and is mirrored into color_description / color_description_as_of.

color_description.description: DERIVED MIRROR of the newest color_observations[] entry's description. Kept for the website's /flock cards and roster.py's VLM prompt block. Do not hand-edit — append a color_observations entry instead.

color_description_as_of.description: DERIVED MIRROR of the newest color_observations[] entry's date. null when that observation's date is unknown.

leg_band.description: The authoritative identifier. NOTE the long-standing key trap: this file spells the side 'side'; config/flock_bands.json spells it 'leg'.
